description: Summary figure: ACAP3 PH pocket basicity against three reference PH-inositol phosphate complexes, residue mapping, vertebrate conservation, and ASAP1 site equivalence
code:
import json, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from matplotlib.patches import Rectangle
res=json.load(open("ph_pocket_three_references.json"))
cons=pd.read_csv("acap3_ortholog_pocket_conservation.csv")

fig=plt.figure(figsize=(14.5,8.6))
gs=fig.add_gridspec(2,2,height_ratios=[1,1.05],hspace=0.42,wspace=0.26)

# --- A: pocket occupancy across three structural references
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,0])
labs=["ASAP1\n5C79 / diC4-PIP2","PLCdelta1\n1MAI / Ins(1,4,5)P3","GRP1\n1FGY / Ins(1,3,4,5)P4"]
keys=["ASAP1_5C79","PLCD1_1MAI","GRP1_1FGY"]
refb=[res[k]['ref_basic'] for k in keys]; refn=[res[k]['ref_n'] for k in keys]
a3b=[res[k]['a3_basic'] for k in keys];  a3n=[res[k]['a3_n'] for k in keys]
x=np.arange(3); w=0.36
ax.bar(x-w/2,refb,w,color="#1b7837",label="reference PH (observed)")
ax.bar(x+w/2,a3b,w,color="#2166ac",label="ACAP3 PH (mapped)")
for i in range(3):
    ax.text(i-w/2,refb[i]+0.12,f"{refb[i]}/{refn[i]}",ha='center',fontsize=9)
    ax.text(i+w/2,a3b[i]+0.12,f"{a3b[i]}/{a3n[i]}",ha='center',fontsize=9)
ax.set_xticks(x); ax.set_xticklabels(labs,fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel("Lys/Arg/His within 5 A of the\nbound inositol phosphate")
ax.set_title("A  Basic residues lining the canonical pocket",loc='left',fontsize=11)
ax.legend(frameon=False,fontsize=9); ax.set_ylim(0,9)
for i,k in enumerate(keys):
    ax.text(i,8.4,f"TM {res[k]['tm']:.2f}",ha='center',fontsize=8,color='#555555')

# --- B: ACAP3 residues recovered in each mapping
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[0,1])
allres=sorted({r[1] for k in keys for r in res[k]['acap3_shell']},
              key=lambda s:int(s[1:]))
Mx=np.zeros((3,len(allres)))
for i,k in enumerate(keys):
    for d,r in res[k]['acap3_shell']:
        Mx[i,allres.index(r)]=d
im=ax.imshow(np.where(Mx==0,np.nan,Mx),cmap="viridis_r",vmin=2,vmax=5,aspect='auto')
ax.set_xticks(range(len(allres)))
ax.set_xticklabels(allres,rotation=90,fontsize=9,
    color='k')
for t,r in zip(ax.get_xticklabels(),allres):
    if r[0] in "KRH": t.set_color("#2166ac"); t.set_fontweight('bold')
ax.set_yticks(range(3)); ax.set_yticklabels(["vs ASAP1","vs PLCdelta1","vs GRP1"],fontsize=9)
plt.colorbar(im,ax=ax,label="distance to ligand (A)",shrink=0.8)
ax.set_title("B  ACAP3 residues placed in the pocket by each superposition\n(blue bold = basic)",
             loc='left',fontsize=11)

# --- C: ortholog conservation
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,0])
cols=[c for c in cons.columns if c not in ("species","acc")]
order=sorted(cols,key=lambda c:int(c[1:]))
pct=[(cons[c]==c[0]).mean()*100 for c in order]
colors=["#2166ac" if c[0] in "KRH" else "#999999" for c in order]
ax.bar(range(len(order)),pct,color=colors)
ax.set_xticks(range(len(order))); ax.set_xticklabels(order,rotation=45,fontsize=9)
ax.set_ylabel(f"% identical across {len(cons)} vertebrate\nACAP3 orthologs")
ax.set_ylim(0,105); ax.axhline(95,ls='--',lw=0.8,color='k')
ax.set_title("C  Conservation of ACAP3 pocket positions (blue = basic)",loc='left',fontsize=11)
for i,(o,p) in enumerate(zip(order,pct)):
    ax.text(i,p+1.5,f"{p:.0f}",ha='center',fontsize=8)

# --- D: equivalence table ASAP1 -> ACAP3
ax=fig.add_subplot(gs[1,1]); ax.axis('off')
rows=json.load(open("csite_equivalence_ASAP1_ACAP3.json"))
rows=[r for r in rows if r[2]!="UNALIGNED" or True]
tbl=[["ASAP1 C site","ACAP3 equivalent","outcome"]]+rows
cmap={"conserved":"#d9f0d3","basic->basic":"#d9f0d3","BASIC LOST":"#fddbc7",
      "other":"#f2f2f2","UNALIGNED":"#eeeeee"}
t=ax.table(cellText=tbl,loc='center',cellLoc='center',colWidths=[0.3,0.33,0.37])
t.auto_set_font_size(False); t.set_fontsize(9); t.scale(1,1.32)
for (i,j),cell in t.get_celld().items():
    if i==0: cell.set_facecolor("#444444"); cell.get_text().set_color("white"); cell.get_text().set_fontweight('bold')
    else: cell.set_facecolor(cmap.get(tbl[i][2],"#ffffff"))
    cell.set_edgecolor("white")
ax.set_title("D  One-to-one equivalence, ASAP1 PtdIns(4,5)P2 site to ACAP3",loc='left',fontsize=11)
fig.suptitle("The ACAP3 PH domain retains a reduced but deeply conserved basic phosphoinositide pocket",
             fontsize=13,y=0.985)
plt.show()
